themes.title: Capivara na lagoa
themes.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished landscape image, approximately 1536x1024, presenting TWO portrait Android app screens side by side on a simple warm neutral presentation background. This is a visual theme prototype for an EXISTING Brazilian Portuguese Flutter word-connect game "Conecte palavras". Screens must look like implementable screenshots, flat straight-on, equal sizes and aligned, no perspective, no hands, no elaborate device hardware. Small theme name above pair and labels "Início" and "Partida" outside screens.
EXISTING APP DESIGN TO PRESERVE: rounded Nunito-like friendly sans typography; dark petrol text #123B49; cream #FFF9EE and #FFF1D5 surfaces; teal #0B5660 primary controls; coral #FF735D accents; honey gold #F4BD4F coins; generous whitespace; cards with 24px corner radius, thin warm borders and soft shadows; buttons subtly raised with gentle gradients, NOT glossy casino style. Charming soft illustrated mascot, stylized natural decorations mostly at edges and bottom; clean large readable interface.
LEFT SCREEN HOME fixed layout: small gear top left, rounded "60 moedas" coin chip top right. Large two-line brand "Conecte" then "palavras", centered upper third, first line dark petrol second line coral. Below brand an illustration with four circular letter chips P A T O linked by a coral trail and the theme mascot at lower right of hero. Below illustration card "Seu progresso" with subtitle "Nível 2" and thin progress bar. Large wide teal play button with play triangle and text "Continuar · Nível 2". Below that rounded cream card with coral calendar icon, "Desafio diário" and subtitle "Um novo desafio por dia", right chevron. Decorative themed landscape along bottom. Keep all cards readable.
RIGHT SCREEN GAME fixed layout: top back arrow on left, gear and coin chip "60 moedas" on right; small row "Nível 2" left, gold star badge "Extras 0/2" right. Center headline "Encontre 3 palavras". Answer area has EXACTLY THREE centered rows of square-ish rounded letter cells: first row 4 filled teal cells spelling P A T O in white, second row 4 EMPTY outlined cells, third row 3 EMPTY outlined cells. Below text "1 de 3 palavras". Next horizontal feedback space centered, small round crossed AD badge to left and two stacked small rounded hint buttons to right: bulb with "30" coin, sparkles with "100" coin. Bottom-middle LARGE clear circular letter wheel, EXACTLY FOUR large letter tokens P at top, A at right, T at bottom, O at left, with small shuffle button in its center. Respect touch area spacing, no decorations overlapping tokens. Instruction beneath "Arraste para ligar as letras". Mascot may be small in bottom corner away from UI.
Use the SAME home/game layout and game state for every theme in this series. Theme changes backdrop, decorative wheel base, mascot, some accents/materials, never functional hierarchy. No cat anywhere. No new navigation, no extra gameplay, no marketing copy, no watermarks. All visible text in accurate Portuguese. Soft warm professionally illustrated casual game aesthetics, visual coherence across home and game.
THEME TITLE: Capivara na lagoa
THEME ART DIRECTION: Warm peach sunset reflected on a calm lagoon, sage-green aquatic plants and water lilies/vitórias-régias at edges. Adorable relaxed brown capybara mascot with a rounded snout and small ears, sitting by the pond, soft illustrated texture. Preserve cream reading areas and teal controls. Letter wheel sits on a small circular grassy island surrounded by a thin shallow-water ripple ring. Small subtle ripples and glints celebrate the filled word. Tranquil, cozy, Brazilian nature mood.
